characterList.description: A man with a beard and brown hair, wearing glasses, a white lab coat, a light blue shirt, a dark blue tie and blue gloves. He is seated at a table in a laboratory setting.
characterList.name: Chemist

content_metadata.description: The video provides a comprehensive demonstration of a titration experiment and the associated calculations to find the concentration of a potassium hydroxide solution.

qAndA.answer: The volume used in Trial 1 was significantly higher than the other trials, indicating that the chemist overshot the endpoint of the titration.
qAndA.question: Why did the chemist discard the data from Trial 1?
What was the average volume of potassium hydroxide solution used in the successful trials?
What was the calculated concentration of the potassium hydroxide solution?

qAndA.answer: The KHP used to make the standard solution could have absorbed some water from the air, as it is hygroscopic, leading to a slightly lower concentration than expected.
qAndA.question: Why was the calculated concentration of the potassium hydroxide solution slightly lower than the target concentration of 0.15 moles per liter?
What was the color of the solutions at the endpoint of the successful titrations?

activities.description: Explaining the recorded titration data and discarding an outlier
Calculating the average volume of potassium hydroxide used in the titration
Performing stoichiometry calculations to determine the unknown concentration of the potassium hydroxide solution
Discussing the calculated results and relating them to the appearance of the titrated samples
Concluding the experiment and discussing cleanup

characterInteraction.description: The chemist is the only character and interacts with the viewers by directly addressing them.

mood.description: Neutral - Curious. The chemist's detailed explanation and calculations create a scientific and informative mood.

narrativeProgression.description: The chemist starts by discussing the titration data.
He explains why one data point is an outlier and needs to be discarded.
He calculates the average volume of the remaining data points.
He discusses the results and their implications for the concentration of the potassium hydroxide solution.
He links the calculated concentration to the visual observations of the titrated samples.

props.name: Whiteboard with calculations and data table
Three Erlenmeyer flasks containing titrated solutions

scenes.thematicElements: The scene focuses on the themes of accuracy, precision, and the importance of careful experimental technique in chemistry.
scenes.title: Data Analysis and Explanation

activities.description: Discussing the importance of making an accurate standard solution, noting any observations that could affect the results, and mentioning the possibility of side reactions.
Thanking the viewers and concluding the video.

He emphasizes the need to note any observations that could affect the results.
He mentions the possibility of side reactions affecting the results.
He thanks the viewers and concludes the video.

youtube_description:
This video wraps up the series with some final observations regarding the titration and showing how to do the stochiometry calculations. 



This is part of a series of videos demonstrating a basic high-school level titration, used in a Chemistry 20 course in Alberta.
